summaries.title: StarCoder: may the source be with you!
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**AI4Science与记忆评测**（Science & Eval）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **StarCoder** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）。核心论点主张：StarCoderBase is trained on 1 trillion tokens sourced from The Stack, a large collection of permissively licensed GitHub repositories with inspection tools and an opt-out...。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。评测基准/数据集涵盖 **HumanEval**；实验规模与算力/平台配置涉及 **15.5B parameter, 1 trillion tokens, 35B**。实验设计与验证细节：We fine-tuned StarCoderBase on 35B Python tokens, resulting in the creation of StarCoder。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **40%**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（We perform the most comprehensive evaluation of Code LLMs to date and show that StarCoderBase outperforms every...；Furthermore, StarCoder outperforms every model that is fine-tuned on Python, can be prompted to achieve 40% pass@1...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 33 赞），本工作为突破 **AI4Science与记忆评测** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.title: Reconstructing Animatable Categories from Videos
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**视觉生成与世界模型**（Vision & World）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「对人工先验规则或定制化流水线的过度依赖」痛点，作者围绕 **Reconstructing Animatable Categories from Videos** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖视觉生成与世界模型（Vision & World）。核心论点主张：We present RAC that builds category 3D models from monocular videos while disentangling variations over instances and motion over time。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：We present RAC that builds category 3D models from monocular videos while disentangling variations over instances and motion over time。

summaries.title: Alternating Gradient Descent and Mixture-of-Experts for Integrated Multimodal Perception
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**多模态与统一基座**（Multimodal）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **Alternating Gradient Descent and Mixture-of-Experts** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖混合专家架构（Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)）、零样本泛化（Zero-Shot Generalization），并引入 Integrated Multimodal Perception (IMP), Alternating Gradient Descent (AGD) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：We present Integrated Multimodal Perception (IMP), a simple and scalable multimodal multi-task training and modeling approach。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用免训练（Training-Free）/零样本适配机制、稀疏专家路由与解耦表征设计、动态记忆槽更新与检索增强机制。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：IMP makes use of a novel design that combines Alternating Gradient Descent (AGD) and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) for efficient model & task scaling。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **77.0%, 76.8%, +5%, +6.7%, +5.8%**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Most notably, we train a sparse IMP-MoE-L focusing on video tasks that achieves new state-of-the-art in zero-shot...；Our model achieves 77.0% on Kinetics-400, 76.8% on Kinetics-600, and 76.8% on Kinetics-700 zero-shot...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 1 赞），本工作为突破 **混合专家与动态深度 (MoE/MoD)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用高质量合成数据构造与精选配比、动态记忆槽更新与检索增强机制。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：Our approach involves using DP training methods to fine-tune a publicly pre-trained LLM on a query generation task。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（We evaluate our method on its ability to securely train effective deep retrieval models, and we observe significant improvements in their retrieval quality without compromising...）。

summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用强化学习策略优化与奖励驱动对齐。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：To this end, we propose a new benchmark called DexArt, which involves Dexterous manipulation with Articulated objects in a physical simulator。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（More details can be found at）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 1 赞），本工作可作为评估 **视频生成与交互世界模型 (Video & World Models)、人形控制与真机灵巧操作 (Humanoid & Manip)** 真实能力上限与诊断失分盲区的标准测试床；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。
